title: 透水鋪面孔隙維護
summary: 以「孔隙堵塞、清掃復原與承載排水協調」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow pore clogging, cleaning recovery and structural drainage through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 有效透水面積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Effective permeable area: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有效透水面積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Effective permeable area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 只有連通且未被覆蓋的面積參與入滲；施工封閉、塗層和補丁需單獨標示。
steps.instructionEn: Only connected uncovered area infiltrates; map closures, coatings and patches separately.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Aeff=A(1-fblocked);A=500;fblocked=0.08；計算 500*(1-0.08) = 460 m2。適用限制：面積帳目，不表示入滲能力均一。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Aeff=A(1-fblocked);A=500;fblocked=0.08; calculation 500*(1-0.08) = 460 m2. Applicability: Area accounting does not imply uniform infiltration.
steps.failure: 把不透水補丁仍算透水面會高估排水。
steps.check: 標出停車格補丁並更新有效面積。
steps.checkEn: Map parking-space patches and update effective area.

steps.title: 現場入滲測試：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Field infiltration testing: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 現場入滲測試 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Field infiltration testing and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 控制試水範圍、預濕和水頭，才能比較維護前後；水量除面積時間得平均速率。
steps.instructionEn: Control test area, prewetting and head for comparisons; volume over area and time gives average rate.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：f=V/(A t);V=0.01 m3;A=0.1 m2;t=0.1 h；計算 0.01/(0.1*0.1) = 1 m/h。適用限制：局部測試，不能直接代表全場。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: f=V/(A t);V=0.01 m3;A=0.1 m2;t=0.1 h; calculation 0.01/(0.1*0.1) = 1 m/h. Applicability: Local test, not automatically site-wide.
steps.failure: 只挑最乾淨位置會掩蓋高負荷區堵塞。
steps.failureEn: Testing the cleanest spot hides loaded-area clogging.
steps.check: 在車輪帶與非車輪帶分別重複測試。
steps.checkEn: Repeat tests in wheel tracks and non-wheel areas.
